description: Land Acquisition - Wellampitiya, Kolonnawa D/S Division, Colombo District
reasoning: This gazette notice is a formal declaration of land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically describes the acquisition of three parcels of land (totaling 1.4323 Hectares) for the purpose of creating a lake as part of the Kolonnawa Storm Water Drainage and Environment Improvement Project. The content includes detailed land descriptions, lot numbers, extents, claimants, and a notice for interested parties to appear for compensation claims. This falls squarely under Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it deals primarily with land acquisition, a core land and property-related matter.
